图-MMU：多模态基准Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for
科学图表Scientific Diagrams

Weihao Bo1,2 Shan Zhang322footnotemark: 2  Yanpeng Sun411footnotemark: 1  Jie Liu2,5 Yongke Yao2,6
Jinhao Du7 Wei He2 Kai Zou8 Zechao Li122footnotemark: 2  Jingdong Wang2‡\ddagger
1]Nanjing University of Science and Technology 2Baidu Inc 3AIML, Adelaide University  4SUTD 5Southeast University 6East China Normal University 7University of Oxford 8NetMind.ai Thanks: Equal contribution  $†$Corresponding Author $‡$Project Lead Affiliation: [ Email: shan.zhang@adelaide.edu.au, yanpeng_sun@sutd.edu.sg
2026 年 8 月 12 日August 12, 2026
摘要Abstract

多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 不断增强科学写作和协作的能力。例如，OpenAI Prism 是一个用于科学写作和协作的免费工作区。 Prism 的一项重要功能是将科学图表直接转化为Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration. One important feature in Prism is turning scientific diagrams directly intoLaTeXTikZ 代码。在本文中，我们构建了一个基准测试，Diagram-MMU， 旨在评估 MLLM 科学图表解析和理解能力的多模态基准。图-MMU 具有跨六个领域的 3,700 个精选图表和 18,300 个经过人工验证的问题。 它针对 vivi 编写工作区中常见的三个任务评估 MLLM：图表到代码解析、图表到代码编辑和图表问答，以及每个任务的代理设置。对 12 个 MLLM 的评估表明，图到代码的任务比图问答更具挑战性：模型可以很好地推理图，但很难解析和编辑它们，这强调了需要增强 MLLM 的图到代码生成能力的方法。在代理设置下，大多数模型都提高了解析和编辑性能，但在回答问题方面却有所下降，而 Claude-4.6 Opus 在所有三项任务上都得到了持续改进。TikZ code. In this paper, we build a benchmark, Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs’ ability for scientific diagram parsing and understanding. Diagram-MMU features 3.7k curated diagrams and 18.3k human-validated questions across six domains. It evaluates MLLMs on three tasks common in vibe writing workspaces: diagram-to-code parsing, diagram-to-code editing, and diagram question answering, alongside agentic settings per task. The evaluation of 12 MLLMs reveals that diagram-to-code tasks are more challenging than diagram question answering: models can reason well over diagrams but struggle to parse and edit them, underscoring the need for methods to enhance MLLMs’ capability in diagram-to-code generation. Under agentic settings, most models improve parsing and editing performance but degrade on question answering, while Claude-4.6 Opus consistently improves across all three tasks.

1 简介Introduction

随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的重大进步In the wake of significant advancements in large language models (LLMs)[1, 2, 3]，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）, multimodal large language models (MLLMs)[4, 5, 6, 7]已经迅速发展以扩展其跨视觉语言任务的多功能性have rapidly evolved to extend their versatility across vision–language tasks[8, 9, 10, 11]。为了将这些功能融入日常研究工作流程中， OpenAI棱镜. To bring these capabilities into everyday research workflows, OpenAI Prism[12]提供一个免费的氛围写作工作区，任何在其中写作的研究人员provides a free vibe writing workspace where any researcher who writes inLaTeX可以起草论文、生成图表以及将科学图表转换为 TikZ 代码。can draft papers, generate figures, and convert scientific diagrams into TikZ code.

科学图表是研究人员传达实验结果、数学关系、分子结构和电路拓扑的主要视觉媒介Scientific diagrams are the primary visual medium through which researchers convey experimental results, mathematical relationships, molecular structures, and circuit topologies[13, 14, 15]。 使用图表的研究人员需要： (1) 将图表解析为可编辑的 TikZ 代码，以便将其包含在手稿中； (2) 编辑图表——更改颜色、标签、数据值或布局——以满足特定要求； (3) 描述或推理图表以解释符号的特定领域语义，甚至执行关于答案如何根据修改后的图表变化的假设推理（假设）。. A researcher working with diagrams needs to: (1) parse a diagram into editable TikZ code so it can be included in a manuscript; (2) edit a diagram–changing colors, labels, data values, or layout–to fit specific requirements; and (3) describe or reason about diagram to interpret domain-specific semantics of symbols, or even perform hypothetical reasoning (what-if) about how answers change conditioned on modified diagrams.

为了协助完成上述任务，MLLM 需要在感知、编码、领域知识和推理方面具备强大的基础能力（To assist with the above tasks, MLLMs need strong foundational abilities in perception, coding, domain knowledge, and reasoning (例如e.g., 如何思考how to think [7]）。此外，在氛围写作工作区中，模型还需要知道). Moreover, in the vibe writing workspace, models also need to know如何行动how to act（代理能力(agentic ability[7])：搜索 TikZ 是否有不熟悉的语法、根据提供的视觉对象进行编码、构建 TikZ 代码以应用编辑，或决定调用哪些步骤来解决任务。大多数现有基准（表): searching TikZ for unfamiliar syntax, coding based on the provided visual objects, building on TikZ codes to apply edits, or deciding which of these steps to invoke for task solving. Most existing benchmarks (Table1）涵盖以 Python 或 SVG 作为代码表示的狭窄图表类型（主要是图表），包括单个任务（编码、编辑或问答），并且当前基准测试在评估期间没有设计代理设置。) cover narrow diagram types (predominantly charts) with Python or SVG as the code representation, include a single task (coding, editing, or question answering), and no current benchmark designs agentic settings during evaluation.

我们引入了Diagram-MMU，这是一种多模态基准测试，旨在评估MLLM在图表到代码解析（D2C-P）、图表到代码编辑（D2C-E）和图表问答（DQA）以及代理评估设置方面的能力。该基准包含精心策划的数据集，源自 TikZ/We introduce Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs’ ability across diagram-to-code parsing (D2C-P), diagram-to-code editing (D2C-E), and diagram question answering (DQA), alongside agentic evaluation settings. This benchmark comprises a carefully curated dataset sourced from TikZ/LaTeX文件，并通过选择和过滤过程来控制质量。最终的 3,744 个独特图表与 18,305 个评估样本配对，由 13 名研究生进行交叉验证。具体来说，（1）我们采用TikZ代码，该代码在论文写作中常用documentations, with a selection and filtering process to control quality. The final 3,744 unique diagrams paired with 18,305 evaluation samples are cross-validated by 13 graduate students. Specifically, (1) we adopt TikZ code, which is commonly used in paper writing inLaTeX并直接集成到 Overleaf 和 Prism 中，涵盖六种科学图表类型，包括图表、平面几何、3D 形状、图表、化学和电路图（图 1）。and integrates directly into Overleaf and Prism, and cover six scientific diagram types including charts, planar geometry, 3D shapes, graphs, chemistry, and circuit diagrams (Fig.1）——首次涵盖图表到代码任务的化学和电路； （2）对于图到代码任务的评估指标，我们使用三个级别：测量视觉外观相似性的图像级、测量语法正确性的代码级以及测量代码绘制的基本对象的对象级 F1 分数； (3)我们设计了16个可控评价设置(表)–for the first time covering chemistry and circuits for diagram-to-code tasks; (2) for evaluation metrics on diagram-to-code tasks, we use three levels: image-level measuring visual appearance similarity, code-level measuring syntactic correctness, and our object-level F1 scores measuring the basic objects that the code draws; (3) we design 16 controllable evaluation settings (Table4)：3 表示基础能力，13 表示代理能力——上下文利用、工具使用、状态管理和规划。重要的是，对于工具使用，我们将 TikZ 搜索工具构建为 MCP 服务器): 3 for foundational ability and 13 for agentic ability–context utilization, tool use, state management, and planning. Importantly, for tool use we build our TikZ search tool as an MCP server[27]，使 MLLM 能够有选择地访问相关参考文献，减少网络搜索的噪音以及加载完整 PDF 手册导致的上下文混乱。, enabling MLLMs to selectively access relevant references, reducing the noise of web search and the context rot caused by loading full PDF manuals.

总体而言，Diagram-MMU 是第一个测试解决科学图表相关任务的基础能力和代理能力的基准。对 12 个 MLLM（6 个闭源、6 个开源）的评估揭示了以下方面的主要发现：Overall, Diagram-MMU is the first benchmark to test both foundational and agentic abilities for solving scientific diagram-related tasks. Evaluation on 12 MLLMs (6 closed-source, 6 open-source) reveals the key findings on基础能力foundational ability：（1）模型可以很好地推理图表（DQA 准确度高达 86%），但很难对其进行编码（D2C-P 对象级 F1 范围 31-57%），揭示了感知和编码的局限性； （2）图到代码解析失败的模型也会在编辑（D2C-E）和回答任务（DQA）方面遇到困难； (3) Gemini-3.0 Pro 在三项任务中实现了最平衡的配置。上: (1) Models can reason well over diagrams (DQA accuracy up to 86%) but struggle to code them (D2C-P object-level F1 ranges 31–57%), revealing perception and coding limitations; (2) Models that fail on diagram-to-code parsing also struggle with editing (D2C-E) and answering tasks (DQA); (3) Gemini-3.0 Pro achieves the most balanced profile across three tasks. On the代理能力agentic ability，（4）机构对编辑的好处比解析更大，可能是因为文本编辑指令有助于指导工具和上下文的使用； （5）大多数模型在 TikZ 搜索过程中因过度检索或针对性较差的查询而退化，而 Claude-4.6 Opus 的工具使用能力最强； (6) 规划是最弱的代理能力，特别是在DQA上（, (4) agency benefits editing more than parsing, likely because textual editing instructions help guide tool and context use; (5) most models degrade from excessive retrieval or poorly targeted queries in the TikZ search process, while Claude-4.6 Opus has the strongest tool use ability; (6) planning is the weakest agentic capability, especially on DQA (−-0.3 至0.3 to−-8.8 精度下降）。图-MMU 作为科学图表解析、编辑和理解氛围写作工作空间的试点评估测试平台，我们希望它能激发进一步的工作。8.8 accuracy degradation). Diagram-MMU serves as a pilot evaluation testbed for scientific diagram parsing, editing, and understanding in vibe writing workspaces, and we hope it inspires further works.

2 相关作品Related Works

大多数现有基准测试都集中在图表上Most existing benchmarks focus on charts[17, 13, 25, 23, 24]或狭义地涵盖科学图表类型or narrowly cover scientific diagram types[18, 20, 21, 15]，其中有几个使用合成图, with several using synthetic diagrams[24, 26, 15]。此外，采用 Python 或 SVG 作为代码表示的基准测试会在外部生成独立的脚本或标记。. Moreover, benchmarks that adopt Python or SVG as the code representation produce standalone scripts or markup outside theLaTeX生态系统，限制了直接融入科学创作环境。我们将图-MMU 与表中现有的图基准进行比较ecosystem, limiting direct integration into scientific authoring environments. We compare Diagram-MMU with existing diagram benchmarks in Table1;附录§中提供了扩展讨论; extended discussion is provided in Appendix §A.

代码表示。Code representation.大多数编码基准测试都采用Python，主要用于图表Most coding benchmarks adopt Python, primarily for charts[14, 17, 23, 24]或 SVG/HTML，用于图标、字体、表情符号和 Web UI, or SVG/HTML, for icons, fonts, emojis and web UI[18, 16]。尽管这些语言很常见，但它们并不是本地语言. Although these languages are common, they are not native toLaTeX：它们由 matplotlib/CairoSVG 渲染为独立图像文件，而不是在其中内联编译: they are rendered by matplotlib/CairoSVG into standalone image files rather than compiled inline withinLaTeX创作环境（背面）。此外，这些是矢量图形，生成低级路径元素，无法维持精确的几何关系或仅生成复杂度有限的输出authoring environments (Overleaf). Moreover, those are vector graphics, generating low-level path elements and fail to maintain accurate geometric relations or only generate outputs of limited complexity[20]。 由于 TikZ 中支持科学的表现力和多样化的包，. Due to the expressiveness and diverse packages supporting science in TikZ,[20, 21, 22]构建基于 TikZ 的基准测试，但仅评估有限图表类型上的图表到代码解析。 Vibe 写作工作区，build TikZ-based benchmarks, but evaluate only diagram-to-code parsing on limited diagram types. Vibe writing workspaces,例如e.g., 棱镜, Prism[12]，进一步推进 TikZ 代码的利用：即使研究人员不熟悉 TikZ 语法，vibe 编写框架也可以帮助他们进行图到代码的解析、编辑，并将输出自动集成到手稿中。因此，我们使用 TikZ 作为代码表示。除了涵盖更广泛的图表类型和评估指标之外，我们还构建了一个 TikZ 搜索工具作为 MCP 服务器，以提供 TikZ 语法参考，以推进 TikZ 集成到 vibe 编写框架中。, further advance the utilization of TikZ code: even researchers are not familiar with TikZ syntax, vibe writing frameworks can assist them in diagram-to-code parsing, editing, and integrating the output automatically into manuscripts. We thus use TikZ as code representation. Beyond covering broader diagram types and evaluation metrics, we also build a TikZ search tool as an MCP server to provide TikZ syntax references to advance TikZ integration into vibe writing frameworks.

任务覆盖范围和问题类型。Task coverage and question types.图EChartE3 [23]为图表和 CharXiv 设计本地和全局编辑模板designs local and global editing templates for charts, and CharXiv[13]介绍用于图表理解的描述性和推理性问题类型；图-MMU 将此类设计从图表扩展到所有六个科学领域。在Diagram-MMU中，每个图表都配有编码、编辑和理解问题进行联合评估，DQA答案是开放式的，由LLM法官评分，避免了多项选择的选择偏差introduces descriptive and reasoning question types for chart understanding; Diagram-MMU extends such designs from charts to all six scientific domains. In Diagram-MMU, each diagram is paired with coding, editing, and understanding questions for joint evaluation, and DQA answers are open-ended and graded by an LLM judge, avoiding the selection bias of multiple-choice[28, 29]或是/否格式。or yes/no formats.

3.1 数据收集Data Collection

来源。Source.如图第一栏所示。As shown in the first column of Fig.2。我们从两个主要来源收集 TikZ 源代码。来源之一是官方软件包手册，. We collect the TikZ source code from two primary sources. 简化， 过滤， 和分类。Simplification, filtering, and categorization.我们通过删除冗余和无用的代码来简化 TikZ 代码， 例如与图表无关的前导码包（We simplify the TikZ code by removing redundant and useless codes, such as preamble packages unrelated to diagrams (例如e.g.，定理环境）。 我们检查正确性 简化的代码 通过两种方式： 编译简化代码 使用, theorem environments). 3.2 任务定义Task Definition

图到代码的传递 (D2C-P)。Diagram-to-Code Pasing (D2C-P).任务是提示 MLLM 将输入图解析为 TikZ 代码。提示的一个示例是“使用 LaTeX 重新创建此图。提供完整的可执行代码。从The task is to prompt the MLLM to parse the input diagram into the TikZ code. An example of the prompt is “Recreate this diagram using LaTeX. Provide the full, executable code. Start with\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{独立}\usepackage{pgfplots}...\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{standalone}\usepackage{pgfplots}...”。它包含以提供的序言（文档类、所需的包和库）为条件的指令。 图最上面一行。”. It contains instruction conditioned on a provided preamble (document class, required packages, and libraries). The top row of Fig.3说明了此任务。illustrates this task.

图表到代码编辑 (D2C-E)。Diagram-to-Code Editing (D2C-E).这个任务 是为了提示MLLM 生成 TiKZ 代码 可以产生渲染的 图表 满足修改要求。 提示的一个示例是“将图像中的图表转换为完整的可执行 LaTeX 代码块，应用以下修改：通过删除连接数据标记的线将折线图转换为散点图。从This task is to prompt the MLLM to generate the TiKZ code that can produce the rendered diagram meeting with the modification requirement. An example of the prompt is “Convert the diagram in the image into a complete, executable LaTeX code block, applying the following modification: convert the line chart to a scatter plot by removing the lines connecting the data markers. Start with\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{独立}\usepackage{pgfplots}...\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{standalone}\usepackage{pgfplots}...” 图中第二行。” The second row of Fig.3举个例子。gives an example.

图解问答（DQA）。Diagram question answering (DQA).此任务是提示 MLLM 回答问题 关于输入图。 提示的示例是 “哪个测试人员类别在旧系统和新系统数据集中具有最大值？” 预期答案是“T4”。图第三行。This task is to prompt the MLLM to answer a question about the input diagram. An example of the prompt is “Which tester category has the maximum value across both the OldSystem and New System datasets?” and the expected answer is “T4”. The third row of Fig.3说明了此任务。illustrates this task.

3.3 任务构建Task Construction

概述。Overview.对于 D2C-P，我们使用固定任务模板，其中占位符直接从原始图表实例化（图 1 的第一行）。For D2C-P, we use fixed task templates with placeholders instantiated directly from the original diagrams (the first row of Fig.3）。对于D2C-E和DQA任务生成，我们设计了一个代理管道，如图1的第三列所示。). For D2C-E and DQA task generation, we design an agentic pipeline, as shown in the third column of Fig.2。给定图表、TikZ 源代码和特定于任务的模板作为输入，代理会生成相应的任务。. Given diagrams, TikZ source codes, and task-specific templates as inputs, an agent generates corresponding tasks.

D2C-E的生成流程包括： (1) 模板预定义 对于每个域； (2) 给定图表， 代理选择两个任务 来自相应域的模板； (3) 生成答案 来自模型； （4）代理检查、修改； (5)人工检查和修改。 DQA任务生成流程与D2C-E类似；仅任务模板不同。The generation pipeline for D2C-E includes: (1) Template predefinition for each domain; (2) Given diagram, agent select two tasks from the templates of the corresponding domain; (3) Generate the answer from models; (4) Agent-check and modification; (5) Human-check and modification. The DQA task generation pipeline is similar to that of D2C-E; only task templates differ.

我们在附录§中提供了详细的代理渠道We provide the detailed agentic pipeline in Appendix §B.2，以及附录§中的所有模板, and all templates in Appendix §B.4&§& §B.6。为了保证质量，我们进行严格的人工审核：所有样本均由 13 名研究生人工审核，每个注释者分配的样本均由另一位注释者交叉验证，以确保语言清晰无歧义，并且问题可以通过逻辑一致的选项和正确的指定答案来回答。. To guarantee quality, we conduct a rigorous manual review: all samples are manually reviewed by 13 graduate students, where each annotator’s assigned samples are cross-validated by another annotator to ensure that the language is clear and unambiguous, and that the question is answerable with logically consistent options and a correct designated answer.

问题类型。Question types.D2C-P 在其任务定义之后有一种标准问题类型：将图表解析为相应的 TikZ 代码。 D2C-E 也遵循标准的编辑格式：提示模型根据变化生成相应的 TikZ 代码，但我们涵盖了四个编辑维度，D2C-P has one standard question type following its task definition: parsing the diagram into the corresponding TikZ code. D2C-E also follows a standard editing format: prompting models to generate the corresponding TikZ code conditioned on the changes, but we cover four editing dimensions,例如e.g.、文本、颜色、范围和布局。示例图如表所示, text, color, scope, and layout. Example illustrations are shown in Table3.

我们在 DQA 中构建了两种类型的问题：描述性问题和推理性问题，总共有 60 个跨 6 个领域的模板（参见附录§We construct two types of questions in DQA: descriptive and reasoning, with a total of 60 templates across the 6 domains (see Appendix §B.6了解详情）。描述性问题评估模型从图表中提取和聚合基本信息的能力，其中正确答案必须严格遵守特定领域的知识，for details). Descriptive questions assess the model’s capability in extracting and aggregating basic information from diagrams, where the correct answer must strictly adhere to domain-specific knowledge,例如e.g.，由一条线连接的两个节点代表平面几何中的几何段，但在化学中代表原子之间的单键。推理问题评估模型执行数值计算的能力，其中正确答案需要应用特定领域的公式和定律，, two nodes connected by a line represent a geometric segment in planar geometry but a single bond between atoms in chemistry. Reasoning questions evaluate the model’s ability to perform numerical computation, where the correct answer requires applying domain-specific formulas and laws,例如e.g.，用于电路分析的欧姆定律，用于几何面积计算的欧几里得公式，或多面体体积的立体几何公式。, Ohm’s law for circuit analysis, Euclidean formulas for geometric area computation, or solid geometry formulas for polyhedron volume.

描述性问题Descriptive questions，由 23 个模板构建，需要：(1) 识别每个域的符号和标记（, constructed from 23 templates, require: (1) identifying symbols and markers per domain (例如e.g.、电路中的电阻器之字形符号、化学中的键类型和官能团、几何中的直角正方形）； (2) 聚合图信息来计数元素（, zigzag symbols as resistors in circuits, bond types and functional groups in chemistry, right-angle squares in geometry); (2) aggregating diagram information to count elements (例如e.g.、几何中的顶点、图表中的刻度/图例、化学中的原子/官能团）并识别类型和数据模式（, vertices in geometry, ticks/legends in charts, atoms/functional groups in chemistry) and to recognize typology and data patterns (例如e.g.，图表中的节点度，图表中的增加/减少趋势）。参见附录§, node degree in graphs, increase/decrease trends in charts). See Appendix §B.7用于数据插图。for data illustrations.

推理题Reasoning questions包括标准问题（由 18 个模板组成）和假设问题（由 19 个模板组成）。假设问题要求模型根据特定元素修改来预测答案，include standard questions (formed by 18 templates) and what-if questions (formed by 19 templates). The what-if questions require the model to predict answer conditioned on a specific element modification,例如e.g.，“如果数据值变为X，那么数据序列的均值是多少？”所有问题都需要：（1）通过应用特定领域的公式进行数值计算（, “if the data value changes to X, what is the mean of the data series?” All questions require: (1) numerical computation by applying domain-specific formulas (例如e.g.图表中的、最小值、最大值和中值；几何中的面积和周长）； （2）图的视觉推理（, min, max, and median in charts; area and perimeter in geometry); (2) visual reasoning over diagram (例如e.g.，图中树的路径长度和高度；化学中键结构的分子特性）。我们的图表 QA 仅需要领域语义/定律和数值计算，而不需要高级专家级知识, path length and height of tree in graphs; molecular properties from bond structure in chemistry). Our diagram QAs require only domain semantics/laws and numerical computation, rather than advanced expert-level knowledge[30, 31]（参见附录§(see Appendix §B.8对于每个域的示例）。for per-domain examples).

3.4 评估指标Evaluation Metrics

图表到代码的解析和编辑。Diagram-to-Code Parsing and Editing.我们评估图表到代码的解析和编辑任务 从三个方面来说： 图像， 代码， 和对象。We evaluation the diagram-to-code parsing and editing tasks from the three aspects: image, code, and object.

基于图像。Image-based.我们将生成的 TikZ 代码和真实的 TikZ 代码编译成图像，并将它们与四个经典指标进行比较，如下论文We compile both generated and ground-truth TikZ code into images and compare them with four classical metrics, following papers[22, 23]:

（1）SSIM(1) SSIM[32]比较亮度、对比度、结构图案（越高越好）；compares brightness, contrast, structure patterns (higher is better);

(2) CLIP评分(2) CLIP Score[33]测量共享视觉语言空间中两个图像之间的语义相似性（越高越好）；measures semantic similarity between two images in a shared vision-language space (higher is better);

(3) LPIPS [34]使用 VGG 网络的深度特征以符合人类判断的方式测量感知距离（越低越好）；uses deep features from a VGG network to measure perceptual distance in a way that matches human judgement (lower is better);

(4)最终诊断结果(4) FID[35]使用初始网络特征比较生成图像和原始图像的分布（越低越好）。compares the distribution of generated and original images using inception network features (lower is better).

这些指标共同评估渲染的输出在视觉上是否与输入图相似。Together, these metrics assess whether the rendered output looks visually similar to the input diagram.

基于代码。Code-based.我们使用 CrystalBLEUWe use CrystalBLEU[36]衡量生成的 TikZ 代码与真实 TikZ 代码之间的相似性，如to measure the similarity between generated and ground-truth TikZ code, as in[20]。这重点关注模型如何再现正确的编码语法和结构。. This focuses on how well the model reproduces the correct coding syntax and structure.

基于对象。Object-based.我们将生成的 TikZ 代码和真实的 TikZ 代码编译为 DVI 并将其转换为 SVG，从中提取语义对象模型 (SOM)——类型化、属性化元素的结构化列表（We compile both generated and ground-truth TikZ code into DVI and convert them to SVG, from which we extract a Semantic Object Model (SOM)—a structured list of typed, attributed elements (例如e.g.、节点、路径、文本标签、数据系列）。然后我们将它们组织成类型、文本、颜色和 BBox（参见附录§, nodes, paths, text labels, data series). We then organize them into type, text, color, and BBox (see Appendix §C.1详细的提取过程）。最后，我们计算生成的 SOM 和真实 SOM 之间的四个 F1 分数，如下所示：for detailed extraction process). Finally, we compute four F1 scores between the generated and ground-truth SOMs, as follows:

(1) F​1t​y​p​e{F1}_{{type}}测量生成的图表是否包含正确类型的元素（measures whether the generated diagram contains the correct types of elements (例如e.g.，节点：圆形和节点：矩形）；, node:circle and node:rectangle);

(2) F1t​e​x​t\mathrm{F1}_{{text}}评估文本标签和数值的精确字符串匹配；evaluates exact string matching of text labels and numeric values;

(3) F​1c​o​l​o​r{F1}_{{color}}使用 CIEDE2000 感知距离通过基于排列的分配来比较元素颜色compares element colors via permutation-based assignment using CIEDE2000 perceptual distance[14];

(4) F​1b​b​o​x{F1}_{{bbox}}通过 Intersection-over-Union (IoUassesses spatial positioning accuracy via Intersection-over-Union (IoU≥0.3\geq 0.3) 元素边界框之间。) between element bounding boxes.

这四个维度共同评估模型是否忠实地重建了图表对象的语义结构、内容和布局。每个维度的 F1 分数的正式公式在附录 § 中提供Together, these four dimensions evaluate whether the model faithfully reconstructs the semantic structure, content and layout of diagram objects. The formal formulation of F1 score per dimension is provided in Appendix §C.2. F​1a​v​g{F1}_{{avg}}是四个维度的平均值：is the average across the four dimensions:14​(F1t​y​p​e+F1t​e​x​t+F1c​o​l​o​r+F1b​b​o​x)\tfrac{1}{4}\left(\mathrm{F1}_{{type}}+\mathrm{F1}_{{text}}+\mathrm{F1}_{{color}}+\mathrm{F1}_{{bbox}}\right).

对于编辑任务，我们进一步将基于代码和基于对象的指标分为两部分：仅保留，对应保持不变的元素进行计算，以及仅编辑，对指令要求更改的元素进行计算。For the editing task, we further split the code- and object-based metrics into two parts: preserve-only, computed over elements that should stay the same, and edit-only, computed over elements that the instruction asks to change.

图问答。Diagram Question Answering.正在关注Following[37]，我们使用准确性来评估图表问答。我们使用 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct 来提取答案并分配二进制分数（0 表示错误，1 表示正确）。评分提示见附录§, we evaluate diagram question answering using accuracy. We use Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct to extract the answer and assign binary scores (0 for incorrect, 1 for correct). The grading prompt is provided in Appendix §C.3.

3.5 评估方案Evaluation Scheme

在真正的科学写作工作流程中，使用图表的 MLLM 需要基础能力，In real scientific writing workflows, MLLMs working with diagrams need foundational abilities,例如e.g.、感知、编码、领域知识和推理，还有知道何时以及如何采取行动的能力（, perception, coding, domain knowledge, and reasoning, but also the ability to know when and how to act (又名a.k.a代理能力）：他们解析图表时可能首先查阅 TikZ 文档以了解不熟悉的语法（工具使用），利用图表中的感知对象编写 TikZ 代码（上下文利用），基于生成的图表代码进行编辑（状态管理），或者决定调用哪些步骤或按什么顺序调用（规划）。据我们所知，Diagram-MMU 是第一个提供 16 种灵活控制设置的基准测试，用于评估当前 MLLM 的基础和代理能力（表agentic capability): they parsing a diagram may first consult TikZ documentation for unfamiliar syntax (tool use), leverage perceptual objects in the diagram to write TikZ code (context utilization), build on generated diagram code to edit (state management), or decide which of these steps to invoke or in what order (planning). Diagram-MMU is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark to provide 16 flexible control settings evaluating both foundational and agentic capability of current MLLMs (Table4）。具体来说，代理能力的四个级别被定义为：（1）上下文利用：模型是否可以利用上下文中与任务相关的信息； (2) 工具使用：知道何时调用工具、查询什么以及如何合并结果； (3) 状态管理：模型是否可以基于先前的输出逐步实现最终目标； (4) 规划：决定需要哪些能力以及如何将它们结合起来解决任务). Specifically, the four levels of agentic ability are defined as: (1) Context utilization: whether models can leverage task-relevant information from context; (2) Tool use: knowing when to invoke tools, what to query, and how to incorporate the results; (3) State management: whether models can build on prior outputs incrementally toward the final goal; (4) Planning: deciding which ability is needed and how to combine them for task solving[38, 39, 40, 41].

为了进行工具使用评估，我们将 TikZ 搜索工具构建为 MCP 服务器。简单的方法（例如网络搜索或加载完整的 PDF 手册）会引入噪音：浏览器可能会返回论坛主题和广告，而完整的手册（For tool use evaluation, we build our TikZ search tool as an MCP server. Naïve approaches such as web search or loading full PDF manuals introduce noise: browsers may return forum threads and advertisements, while complete manuals (例如e.g., PGFPlots 参考跨度, the PGFPlots reference spans∼{\sim}560 页）导致上下文腐烂。我们使用 Mintlify560 pages) cause context rot. We use Mintlify11 1 https://mintlify.com从精选的 TikZ 文档生成 MCP 服务器，从而可以选择性地访问相关参考文献，而不是摄取整个文档。 MCP 作为一个统一的工具接口，允许任何 MLLM 查询语法参考，而无需特定于模型的实现（详细信息参见附录§to generate an MCP server from curated TikZ documentation, enabling selective access to relevant references instead of ingesting entire documents. MCP serves as a unified tool interface, allowing any MLLM to query syntax references without model-specific implementations (details in Appendix §F).

我们并不声称图-MMU 评估了代理能力的全部范围；作为评估氛围写作中代理能力的试点基准。We do not claim Diagram-MMU evaluates the full spectrum of agentic ability; as a pilot benchmark for evaluating agentic ability in vibe writing w.r.t.从图表到代码和理解任务，我们的覆盖范围仅针对某些方面。我们在附录§中讨论限制diagram-to-code and understanding tasks, our coverage targets only certain aspects. We discuss limitations in Appendix §H并希望激发未来的努力，在氛围写作工作空间中推进更彻底的代理评估维度。and hope to inspire future efforts to advance more thorough agentic evaluation dimensions in the vibe writing workspaces.

结果。Results.图。Fig.4报告F1reports F1平均avg适用于 D2C-P、F1for D2C-P, F1平均avg（仅编辑）D2C-E，以及 DQA 的准确性（参见§(edit-only) for D2C-E, and accuracy for DQA (see §4以获得详细结果和分析。）for detailed results and analysis.)

基础能力Foundational capacity：当前模型的推理能力较强，但感知和编码能力较弱，揭示了一个有趣的不对称性：它们在知识密集型评估方面表现出色，但仍难以将视觉对象与编码技能联系起来。简而言之，模型可以对图表进行深入推理，但无法对它们进行编码——视觉感知的弱点与 BabyVision 的发现一致: current models show stronger capability on reasoning but weaker ability on perception and coding, revealing an interesting asymmetry: they excel in knowledge-intensive evaluations but still struggle to link visual objects to coding skills. In short, models can reason deeply over diagrams but fail to code over them–a visual perception weakness aligned with the findings of BabyVision[42]。总体而言，Gemini-3.0 Pro 实现了最平衡的配置。. Overall, Gemini-3.0 Pro achieves the most balanced profile.

代理能力Agentic capacity：在整个编码任务中，闭源模型在 D2C-E 上表现出比 D2C-P 更强的代理性。例如，GPT-5.2 在 D2C-P 上下降 -0.1，但在 D2C-E 上增加 +3.0；我们假设文本编辑指令有助于指导模型知道何时使用工具以及什么上下文对目标编辑有用。对于DQA，与直接回答不同（输入图: Across the coding tasks, closed-source models show stronger agency on D2C-E than D2C-P. For example, GPT-5.2 drops -0.1 on D2C-P but gains +3.0 on D2C-E; we hypothesize that the textual editing instructions help guide models to know when to use tools and what context is useful for target editing. For DQA, unlike direct answering (input diagram→\to答案），在代理设置中，模型计划在需要时调用图到代码解析（输入图answer), in the agentic setting the model plans to invoke diagram-to-code parsing when needed (input diagram→\toTikZ 代码TikZ code→\to答案）并决定在 TikZ 搜索工具中查询什么。除了 Claude-4.6 Opus (+0.4) 之外，所有模型在 DQA 上都会退化，暴露出复杂任务的规划能力较弱，但更关键的是，揭示了模型无法有效地将代码映射到高级推理。answer) and decides what to query in the TikZ search tool. Except for Claude-4.6 Opus (+0.4), all models degrade on DQA, exposing weak planning ability for complex tasks, but more critically, revealing that models cannot effectively map codes to high-level reasoning.

(1)开源模型在物体感知方面的性能差距较大。(1) A larger performance gap among open-source models in object perception.D2C-P 需要模型感知基本对象并将其集成到代码中。基于图像的指标衡量视觉外观相似度；所有通用模型在这里得分最高，并且闭源模型和开源模型之间的差距很小（D2C-P requires models to perceive basic objects and integrate them into code. Image-based metrics measure visual appearance similarity; all general-purpose models score highest here, and the gap between closed- and open-source models is small (例如e.g.，闭源模型达到 62.33–75.48，开源模型达到 61.02–77.31）。 在编码语法和结构评估 (CrystalBLEU) 中，通用模型得分最低，差距也同样较小（闭源：28.81–32.88；开源：30.91–37.92）。然而，在物体感知方面出现了更大的差距：闭源F1, closed-source models achieve 62.33–75.48 and open-source models 61.02–77.31). At coding syntax and structure evaluation (CrystalBLEU), generic models score lowest, with a similarly small gap (closed-source: 28.81–32.88; open-source: 30.91–37.92). However, a larger gap emerges at object perception: closed-source F1avg{}_{\text{avg}}集群在 47.57-54.64 之间，而开源则跨越 31.47-57.48，而专业的 TikZero+ 则远远落后，仅为 15.43。 这意味着生成的图表可能在图像级别上看起来看似合理，但在对象级别上包含不正确的标识。clusters within 47.57–54.64, while open-source spans 31.47–57.48, and the specialist TikZero+ trails far behind at only 15.43. This means a generated diagram may appear visually plausible at image level yet contain incorrect identification at object level.

(2) 模型遵循编辑指令，但很难生成匹配的代码。(2) Models follow editing instructions but struggle to produce matching code.在编辑任务中，模型在编辑分区上仅达到 0.51-2.98 CrystalBLEU，但获得了相对较高的对象 F1 分数，这表明它们可以根据编辑指令生成正确的对象，但无法将它们放置在正确的位置或格式以匹配地面实况代码。In the editing task, models reach only 0.51–2.98 CrystalBLEU on the edit partitions, yet achieve relatively higher object F1 scores, indicating they may generate the correct objects in line with the editing instructions but fail to place them at the correct positions or formats to match the ground truth code.

(3) 在 D2C-P 上失败的模型也会在 D2C-E 和 DU 上遇到困难。(3) Models failing on D2C-P also struggle with D2C-E and DU.我们根据 D2C-P 是否生成可执行的 TikZ 代码将图分成两组（图 1）。We split diagrams into two sets conditioned on whether D2C-P produces executable TikZ code (Fig.7）。在 D2C-P 成功的图表中，模型始终比 D2C-P 失败时获得更高的 D2C-E 分数：对象 F1). On diagrams where D2C-P succeeds, models consistently achieve higher D2C-E scores than on D2C-P failures: the object F1avg{}_{\text{avg}}（仅保留和仅编辑的平均值）在大多数模型和代码长度中，两组之间的差距达到 20-40 个点。类似的模式也适用于代码级指标。 甚至模型在编辑过程中也可以在 D2C-P 渲染失败的图表上生成可执行的 TikZ 代码；这不会产生准确的编辑。我们假设这种可执行的 TikZ 是由文本编辑指令产生的，它指导代码生成，(average of preserve-only&edit-only) gap between the two sets reaches 20–40 points across most models and code lengths. The similar pattern holds at code-level metrics. Even models can produce executable TikZ code on D2C-P failed-rendering diagrams during editing; this does not yield accurate editing. We hypothesize that such executable TikZ results from textual editing instructions, which guide code generation,例如e.g.，利用模型更强的文本到代码的能力, leveraging the model’s stronger text-to-code ability[2, 3].

(4) 模型难以应对细粒度的空间基础。(4) Models struggle with fine-grained spatial grounding.所有六个模型在文本提取和颜色识别方面都取得了较高的性能（图 2）。All six models achieve relatively high performance on text extraction and color recognition (Fig.6）。然而，空间基础（bbox）始终是最弱的感知维度。虽然模型可以识别存在哪些元素，但它们很难对它们所在的位置进行编码。 这种差距在 GPT-5.2 和 Claude-4.6 Opus 中最为明显，它们在类型、文本和颜色上的得分均为 62-71，但在 bbox 上只有 8.0 和 9.2。 D2C-E 中的编辑指令仅在保留的元素上弥补这一弱点，而不是在新编辑的元素上：Claude-4.6 Opus 的 F1). However, spatial grounding (bbox) is consistently the weakest perception dimension. While models can recognize what elements exist, they struggle to encode where they are located. This deficit is sharpest for GPT-5.2 and Claude-4.6 Opus, where both score 62–71 on type, text, and color yet only 8.0 and 9.2 on bbox. Editing instructions in D2C-E compensate for this weakness only on preserved elements, not on newly edited ones: Claude-4.6 Opus’s F1bbox{}_{\text{bbox}}保留上从 9.2 上升到 24.3，GPT-5.2 从 8.0 上升到 20.8；但是，仅编辑 F1rises from 9.2 to 24.3 on preserve, and GPT-5.2 from 8.0 to 20.8; however, edit-only F1bbox{}_{\text{bbox}}分别下降到 3.0 和 2.3，因为放置新引入的元素比保留现有元素更困难。然而，Qwen3-VL-8B 在每个感知维度上都落后于所有模型。drops to 3.0 and 2.3, respectively, since placing newly introduced elements is harder than retaining existing ones. Qwen3-VL-8B, however, falls behind all models across every perception dimension.

(5) 模型在所有三项任务中最难处理 3D 形状。(5) Models struggle most with 3D shapes across all three tasks.3D 形状对所有三项任务中的闭源和开源模型都构成了最大的挑战，这可能是由于预训练语料库中 TikZ-3D 训练样本的稀缺。对于 D2C-P 和 D2C-E，图表是继 3D 之后第二个最具挑战性的领域，因为它们包含更高密度的小规模元素（3D shapes pose the greatest challenge for both closed- and open-source models across all three tasks, likely due to the scarcity of TikZ-3D training samples in pretraining corpora. For D2C-P and D2C-E, charts are the second most challenging domain after 3D, as they contain a higher density of small-scale elements (例如e.g.、刻度标签、数据标记）。特定于模型的 DQA 弱点在 3D 之外有所不同：Seed-2.0 Pro 在排行榜上显着下降； Claude-4.6 Opus 在图结构上表现不佳； Gemini-3.0 Pro 在电路上的精度相对较低（见表, tick labels, data markers). Model-specific DQA weaknesses diverge beyond 3D: Seed-2.0 Pro drops notably on charts; Claude-4.6 Opus underperforms on graph structures; and Gemini-3.0 Pro shows relatively lower accuracy on circuits (see TableG.3在附录§中in Appendix §G.3).

代理能力。Agentic Capacity.我们选择一个We select a迷你mini分为 300 个图（每个域 50 个）和 1,500 个 QA 实例（D2C-P/D2C-E/DQA 为 300/600/600），在 6 个代表性模型上进行评估：Seed-2.0 Pro、Claude-4.6 Opus、GPT-5.2、Gemini-3.0 Pro、Gemini-3.1 Pro 和 Qwen3-VL-8B。split of 300 diagrams (50 per domain) with 1,500 QA instances (300/600/600 for D2C-P/D2C-E/DQA), evaluated on 6 representative models: Seed-2.0 Pro, Claude-4.6 Opus, GPT-5.2, Gemini-3.0 Pro, Gemini-3.1 Pro, and Qwen3-VL-8B.

(1) 上下文利用。(1) Context utilization.我们提供图表对象作为所有三个任务的上下文（表We provide diagram objects as context across all three tasks (Tables6和and7）。在 D2C-E 上，对象一致地改进所有模型：F1). On D2C-E, objects improve all models consistently: F1avg{}_{\text{avg}}保存时获得 4.1–10.6，编辑时获得 3.3–7.1；因此，对象可以帮助模型找到要保留哪些元素以及要修改哪些元素。在 D2C-P 上，结果好坏参半：四个模型增益，而 Gemini-3.0 Pro (-2.0) 和 Qwen3-VL-8B (-6.1) 下降。在代码级别，只有 Claude-4.6 Opus (+0.3) 和 Gemini-3.1 Pro (+1.4) 有所增益，表明对象比代码合成更有助于元素感知。在 DQA 上，大多数模型都受益，而 GPT-5.2 急剧下降（-7.3），表明它无法将低级对象映射到语义推理。gains 4.1–10.6 on preserve and 3.3–7.1 on edit; thus objects may help models locate which elements to keep and which to modify. On D2C-P, results are mixed: four models gain, while Gemini-3.0 Pro (-2.0) and Qwen3-VL-8B (-6.1) degrade. At code level, only Claude-4.6 Opus (+0.3) and Gemini-3.1 Pro (+1.4) gain, showing objects aid element perception more than code synthesis. On DQA, most models benefit, while GPT-5.2 drops sharply (-7.3), indicating it cannot map low-level objects to semantic reasoning.

外卖：Takeaway:大多数模型可以使用对象来进行本地编辑，但很难将它们集成到语法或领域知识推理中。Most models can use objects to ground local edits but struggle to integrate them into syntax or domian knowledege reasoning.

(2)工具的使用。(2) Tool use.大多数模型的工具调用能力较弱。最严重的失败是Gemini-3.1 Pro（-4.3 F1Most models exhibit weak tool-calling ability. The sharpest failure is Gemini-3.1 Pro (-4.3 F1平均avg在 D2C-P 上）。对轨迹的手动检查表明，模型在没有明确停止标准的情况下迭代查询，导致上下文腐烂，直到被令牌长度限制终止（附录§中的工具调用计数和失败率）on D2C-P). Manual inspection of trajectory reveals that model iteratively queries without a clear stopping criterion, causing context rot until terminated by the token-length limit (tool-call counts and failure rates in Appendix §G.4）； Qwen3-VL-8B 轨迹问题的查询针对性较差，缺乏在搜索工具中查询内容的能力。 Claude-4.6 Opus 表现最佳，在两个 DC 上都有一致的增益（+2.2 F1); Qwen3-VL-8B trajectory issues poorly targeted queries, lacking ability of what to query in the search tool. Claude-4.6 Opus performs best, with consistent gains on both DC (+2.2 F1平均avg）和DE（+4.4/+2.2）。) and DE (+4.4/+2.2).

外卖：Takeaway:只有 Claude-4.6 Opus 始终受益于工具访问； Gemini-3.1 Pro 存在检索过多问题； Qwen3-VL-8B 查询失败。Only Claude-4.6 Opus consistently benefits from tool access; Gemini-3.1 Pro suffers from excessive retrieval; Qwen3-VL-8B fails at querying.

(3)状态管理。(3) State management.我们要求模型首先生成图表的 TikZ 代码，然后基于它进行编辑 (D2C-E) 或回答 (DQA)。在 D2C-E 上，大多数型号在保留 F1 时降级We require models to first generate the diagram’s TikZ code, then build upon it for editing (D2C-E) or answering (DQA). On D2C-E, most models degrade on preserve F1avg{}_{\text{avg}}，表明管理中间代码状态以进行精确编辑的限制。 Claude-4.6 Opus (+2.5/+2.6) 和 GPT-5.2 (+2.5/+3.5) 是例外，它们成功地构建在其生成的代码之上。在 DQA 上，Claude-4.6 Opus 大幅提升（+3.8），Seed-2.0 Pro 略有提升（+0.8），而所有其他模型则下降（-1.3 至 -3.2）。, indicating the limitation of managing intermediate code states for precise editing. Claude-4.6 Opus (+2.5/+2.6) and GPT-5.2 (+2.5/+3.5) are exceptions, successfully building on their generated code. On DQA, Claude-4.6 Opus gains substantially (+3.8) and Seed-2.0 Pro gains marginally (+0.8), while all other models degrade (-1.3 to -3.2).

外卖：Takeaway:大多数模型无法跨步骤管理中间代码状态；只有 Claude-4.6 Opus 保持了从编码到编辑和推理的连贯性。Most models fail to manage intermediate code states across steps; only Claude-4.6 Opus maintains coherence from coding to editing&reasoning.

(4)规划。(4) Planning.我们测试模型是否可以协调多种代理能力：将对象与 D2C-P 的工具使用相结合，在编辑或回答之前选择性地生成代码，以及协调工具的使用与可选的代码生成（D2C-E 和 DU）。在 D2C-P 上，Claude-4.6 Opus (+5.1/+2.8) 和 Seed-2.0 Pro (+2.6/+1.5) 成功协调这两种资源，而 (-1.6/-4.1)、Gemini-3.1 Pro (-5.0/-4.5) 和 Qwen3-VL-8B (-5.6/-6.4) 则性能下降。在 D2C-E 上，大多数模型在可选代码生成下显示出边际或负面变化；添加工具访问权限可以恢复 Claude-4.6 Opus (+4.1/+3.0) 和 GPT-5.2 (+2.6/+1.9)，但会降低 Gemini-3.1 Pro (-4.4/-0.9) 的性能。在 DQA 上，所有六个模型在可选代码生成下都会降级，并且添加工具访问会加剧 Seed-2.0 Pro (-8.8) 和 GPT-5.2 (-5.7) 的降级。We test whether models can coordinate multiple agentic abilities: combining objects with tool use for D2C-P, optionally generating code before editing or answering, and coordinating tool use with optional code generation (D2C-E and DU). On D2C-P, Claude-4.6 Opus (+5.1/+2.8) and Seed-2.0 Pro (+2.6/+1.5) coordinate both resources successfully, while (-1.6/-4.1), Gemini-3.1 Pro (-5.0/-4.5), and Qwen3-VL-8B (-5.6/-6.4) degrade. On D2C-E, most models show marginal or negative changes under optional code generation; adding tool access recovers Claude-4.6 Opus (+4.1/+3.0) and GPT-5.2 (+2.6/+1.9), but degrades Gemini-3.1 Pro (-4.4/-0.9). On DQA, all six models degrade under optional code generation, and adding tool access amplifies degradation for Seed-2.0 Pro (-8.8) and GPT-5.2 (-5.7).

外卖：Takeaway:计划是最弱的代理能力；随着任务复杂性从 D2C-P 增长到 DQA，没有任何模型能够可靠地组合多种能力。Planning is the weakest agentic capability; no model reliably composes multiple abilities as task complexity grows from D2C-P to DQA.

5 结论Conclusion

科学图表是表达抽象思想的重要视觉媒介，它们的 TikZ 代码表示可以在本机内联编译Scientific diagrams are an important visual medium for expressing abstract ideas, and their TikZ code representation can be natively compiled inline withinLaTeX在撰写科学论文期间。 Vibe 写作平台提供 MLLM 辅助论文写作，其中一项重要功能是将科学图表直接转换为 TikZ 代码。我们推出了 Diagram-MMU，这是一个基于 TikZ 的基准测试，具有 16 种评估设置，涵盖图表到代码的解析、编辑和理解以及每个任务的代理设置。我们还构建了一个 TikZ 搜索工具作为 MCP 服务器，任何模型都可以有选择地查询 TikZ 语法引用，而无需任何特定于模型的实现。对12个MLLM的综合评估揭示了它们在将图编码为TikZ方面的弱点，以及更强的代理能力，during scientific paper writing. Vibe writing platforms provide MLLM-assisted paper writing, and one important feature is converting scientific diagrams directly into TikZ code. We present Diagram-MMU, a TikZ-based benchmark with 16 evaluation settings across diagram-to-code parsing, editing, and understanding alongside agentic settings per task. We also build a TikZ search tool as an MCP server that any model can selectively query TikZ syntactic references without any model-specific implementations. Comprehensive evaluation of 12 MLLMs reveals their weaknesses in coding diagrams into TikZ, and stronger agentic abilities,例如e.g.、上下文利用和工具使用可能会有所帮助。我们希望我们的分析能够激发进一步的研究，以建立更彻底的评估设置并开发方法来改进 MLLM 辅助的氛围写作工作空间。, context utilization and tool use, could help. We hope our analysis can inspire further research to build more thorough evaluation settings and develop methods to improve MLLM-assisted vibe writing workspaces.

A.1 图解析Diagram Parsing

图解析提取图的拓扑，Diagram parsing extracts the topology of a diagram,例如e.g.、基本要素及其关系。这需要符号感知而不是像素级理解。几何基元作为符号具有意义：其语义来自其类型、路径和空间关系，而不是来自其像素值。例如，无论其颜色、大小或线条粗细如何，圆仍然是圆。这与自然图像形成鲜明对比，自然图像中每个像素通过颜色、纹理和强度贡献语义内容。这种区别解释了为什么在自然图像任务上表现良好的 MLLM 却难以处理图表, the basic elements and their relationships. This requires symbolic perception instead of pixel-level understanding. A geometric primitive carries meaning as a symbol: its semantics come from its type, path and spatial relationships, not from its pixel values. For example, a circle remains a circle regardless of its color, size or line thickness. This contrasts with natural images, where each pixel contributes semantic content through color, texture, and intensity. This distinction explains why MLLMs that perform well on natural image tasks struggle with diagrams[15]。 一种常见的替代方法是光学字符识别 (OCR)，其中模型提取文本注释来解释图表。然而，OCR仅捕获文本内容，而忽略几何拓扑，因此无法提取结构关系. A common surrogate is Optical Character Recognition (OCR), where models extract text annotations to interpret diagrams. However, OCR captures only textual content while ignoring geometric topology, thus failing at structural relationship extraction[50, 51]。因此，科学图表和实体关系 (ER) 模式等特定领域图表的错误率仍然很高. Consequently, error rates remain high for domain-specific diagrams like scientific charts and Entity-Relationship (ER) schemas[52]。为了解决这个问题，最近的工作将视觉解析与领域本体集成起来. To address this, recent work integrates visual parsing with domain ontologies[53]或使用区域分解or uses Region Decomposition[54]。这些方法捕获跨节点依赖性，将像素级特征转换为高级语义。另一种工作将图表表示为代码，称为图表到代码解析，这是本文的重点。我们在§中回顾了这些方法. These methods capture cross-node dependencies, transforming pixel-level features into high-level semantics. An alternative line of work represents diagrams as code, called diagram-to-code parsing, which is the focus of this paper. We review these methods in §2表格(&T)&Tabel1.

A.2 图表编辑Diagram Editing

图表编辑正在从手动图形操作转向使用自然语言的意图驱动编辑Diagram editing is shifting from manual graphical manipulation to intent-driven editing using natural language[55, 19]。与通过扩散模型进行的一般图像编辑不同，编辑技术图表需要严格的全局逻辑一致性。模型必须修改局部属性而不造成结构损坏. Unlike general image editing via diffusion models, editing technical diagrams requires strict global logical coherence. Models must modify local attributes without causing structural damage[56]。最近的框架通过解析指令并直接修改矢量图形或代码来解决这个问题. Recent frameworks solve this by parsing instructions and modifying vector graphics or code directly[57]。例如，DiagramAgent 使用多代理系统。它将用户指令分解为明确的计划，允许专门的代理协作编辑和验证. For example, DiagramAgent uses a multi-agent system. It decomposes user instructions into explicit plans, allowing specialized agents to collaboratively edit and verifyLaTeX/TikZ 或 DOT 表示/TikZ or DOT representations[58]。其他方法将视觉表示学习与自回归框架相结合，例如 VAREdit. Other methods combine visual representation learning with autoregressive frameworks, such as VAREdit[59]。这些方法弥合了语言意图和矢量图形之间的差距，安全地处理复杂的拓扑变化。. These approaches bridge the gap between language intents and vector graphics, safely handling complex topological changes.

A.3 氛围写作Vibe Writing

带振动编码With vibe coding[60]，研究人员提供图表并用自然语言描述所需的更改，MLLM 生成可编译代码；从根本上来说依赖于强大的图表到代码生成的工作流程。在视频编写环境中，人类创作者不再需要编写繁琐的宏或计算坐标。通过提供简单的逻辑意图或振动，用户引导多模式代理自主处理结构推理、代码合成和视觉渲染。这从根本上重塑了研究人员创建学术文献和图表的方式。, researchers provide a diagram and describe the desired changes in natural language, and an MLLM generates the compilable code; a workflow that fundamentally depends on strong diagram-to-code generation. In the vide writing environment, human creators no longer need to write tedious macros or calculate coordinates. By providing simple logical intents or vibes, users guide multimodal agents to autonomously handle structural inference, code synthesis, and visual rendering. This radically reshapes how researchers create academic literature and diagrams.

生成高精度 TikZ/Generating highly precise TikZ/LaTeX代码是主要研究焦点code is a major research focus[20]。然而，高质量的图表代码对很稀缺。为了解决这个问题，像 TikZero 这样的模型使用零样本架构来解耦视觉和文本特征. However, high-quality diagram-code pairs are scarce. To address this, models like TikZero use zero-shot architectures to decouple visual and textual features[49]。同样，DeTikZify 使用蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 和编译器反馈来优化生成的 TikZ 代码. Similarly, DeTikZify optimizes generated TikZ code using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and compiler feedback[21]。此外，TikZilla 使用强化学习 (RL) 和反向图形奖励提高视觉保真度. Furthermore, TikZilla improves visual fidelity using Reinforcement Learning (RL) and inverse graphics rewards[61]，而 MathCoder-VL 使用“模型在环”策略合成大量对齐的数据集, while MathCoder-VL synthesizes massive aligned datasets using a “model-in-the-loop” strategy[62].

B.2 任务生成管道Task Generation Pipeline

图Figure2说明了整体基准建设管道。在这里，我们详细介绍特定于任务的生成过程：illustrates the overall benchmark construction pipeline. Herein, we detail the task-specific generation procedure:

(1)图到代码解析(D2C-P)。(1) Diagram-to-Code Parsing (D2C-P).D2C-P 使用直接从原始图表实例化的固定任务模板。任务问题要求模型将图表图像转换为可编译的 TikZ 代码，以提供的序言（文档类、所需的包和库）为条件。原始 TikZ 源代码作为真实答案。此任务不需要代理生成。D2C-P uses fixed task templates instantiated directly from the original diagrams. The task question asks the model to convert the diagram image into compilable TikZ code, conditioned on a provided preamble (document class, required packages, and libraries). The original TikZ source code serves as the ground-truth answer. No agentic generation is required for this task.

(2) 图表到代码编辑 (D2C-E)。(2) Diagram-to-Code Editing (D2C-E).D2C-E 采用具有两个主要组件的代理管道：D2C-E employs an agentic pipeline with two main components: a代剂generation agent（Gemini-3 Flash）和(Gemini-3 Flash) and a验证代理verifier agent包括两个用于交叉验证的判断模型（GPT-5.2 和 Gemini-3 Pro）。管道进行如下：comprising two judge models (GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 Pro) for cross-validation. The pipeline proceeds as follows:

  • •

    模板预定义。Template predefinition.我们为六个领域中的每一个领域手动设计了跨四个维度（文本、颜色、范围、布局）的编辑任务模板池（表We manually design a pool of editing task templates across four dimensions (text, color, scope, layout) for each of the six domains (Table3）。每个模板都包含图表特定元素的占位符（). Each template contains placeholders for diagram-specific elements (例如e.g.、标签、颜色、顶点和边）。, labels, colors, vertices, and edges).

  • •

    任务选择。Task selection.给定一个图表及其 TikZ 源代码，生成代理从相应域的模板池中选择两个编辑任务，限制覆盖不同的编辑维度以确保多样性。Given a diagram and its TikZ source code, the generation agent selects two editing tasks from the template pool of the corresponding domain, constrained to cover distinct editing dimensions to ensure diversity.

  • •

    答案生成。Answer generation.生成代理使用特定的图表元素实例化选定的模板，并生成相应的修改后的 TikZ 代码。多引擎编译（The generation agent instantiates the selected templates with specific diagram elements and generates the corresponding modified TikZ code. Multi-engine compilation (pdf乳胶pdflatex→\rightarrow卢拉泰克斯lualatex→\rightarrow赛拉泰克斯xelatex）执行以验证可执行性。) is performed to verify executability.

  • •

    代理验证。Agent verification.验证者代理根据预定义的标准评估生成的结果：所有编辑都必须是视觉可见的并符合所选的编辑维度，并且不受影响的元素必须保持不变。只有当两个验证代理都同意时，案件才会被接受。The verifier agents evaluate generated results against predefined criteria: all edits must be visually observable and conform to the selected editing dimension, and unaffected elements must remain unchanged. A case is accepted only when both verifier agents agree.

  • •

    迭代细化。Iterative refinement.失败的案例与验证者反馈一起返回给生成代理进行再生，最多尝试三次。Failed cases, together with verifier feedback, are returned to the generation agent for regeneration, with a maximum of three attempts.

  • •

    人工验证。Human verification.所有接受的实例均由 13 名研究生手动审核。每个注释者分配的实例都由另一个注释者交叉验证，以确保语言清晰度、逻辑一致性和答案正确性。All accepted instances are manually reviewed by 13 graduate students. Each annotator’s assigned instances are cross-validated by another annotator to ensure language clarity, logical consistency, and answer correctness.

(3)图问答(DQA)。(3) Diagram Question Answering (DQA).DQA 生成管道遵循与 D2C-E 相同的代理工作流程；只是任务模板不同。生成代理根据图表、其 TikZ 源代码以及编码符号语义和领域知识的特定领域模板生成描述性和推理问题（§The DQA generation pipeline follows the same agentic workflow as D2C-E; only the task templates differ. The generation agent produces descriptive and reasoning questions based on the diagram, its TikZ source code, and domain-specific templates encoding symbol semantics and domain knowledge (§B.6）。模板占位符是使用从源代码中提取的图表元素来实例化的。例如，在有机化学中，官能团（). Template placeholders are instantiated using diagram elements extracted from the source code. For example, in organic chemistry, functional groups (例如e.g.、COOH 或 OH）被提取以产生诸如“该分子中存在哪个官能团？”之类的问题。然后，验证代理评估每个（图表、问题、答案）三元组与视觉证据和领域知识的逻辑一致性；允许使用验证者反馈进行最多三次尝试，并且仅保留经过验证的 QA 对。人工验证遵循与 D2C-E 相同的交叉验证协议。, COOH or OH) are extracted to generate questions such as “which functional group is present in this molecule?”. The verifier agents then assess each (diagram, question, answer) triple for logical consistency with both visual evidence and domain knowledge; regeneration with verifier feedback is allowed for up to three attempts, and only validated QA pairs are retained. Human verification follows the same cross-validation protocol as D2C-E.

每个图产生五个评估实例（1 D2C-P + 2 D2C-E + 2 DQA）。模板引导的选择增强了维度多样性：D2C-E 实例涵盖每个图表的不同编辑维度，DQA 问题涵盖描述性和推理类型。所有模板和标题设计均在§中详细说明Each diagram yields five evaluation instances (1 D2C-P + 2 D2C-E + 2 DQA). The template-guided selection enforces dimensional diversity: D2C-E instances cover distinct editing dimensions per diagram, and DQA questions span both descriptive and reasoning types. All templates and rubric designs are detailed in §B.4和§and §B.6.

C.1 语义对象模型 (SOM) 管道Semantic Object Model (SOM) Pipeline

我们基于对象的指标评估模型是否正确感知代码绘制的基本对象。我们将生成的 TikZ 代码和真实的 TikZ 代码解析为一组图形对象（它们的类型、文本内容、颜色和边界框），并计算每个维度的 F1 分数。提取过程分为三个阶段：语义注入、编译和基于 DOM 的提取。Our object-based metric evaluates whether the model correctly perceives basic objects that the code draws. We parse both generated and ground-truth TikZ code into a set of graphical objects—their type, text content, color, and bounding box—and compute F1 scores for each dimension. The extraction proceeds through three stages: semantic injection, compilation, and DOM-based extraction.

基于代码的度量计算。Code-based metric computation.我们使用 CrystalBLEUWe use CrystalBLEU[36]测量生成的 TikZ 代码和真实 TikZ 代码之间的标记级相似性。 CrystalBLEU 通过过滤掉普通共享的 n 元模型（高频、低信息标记，例如to measure token-level similarity between generated and ground-truth TikZ code. CrystalBLEU extends standard BLEU-4 by filtering out trivially shared n-grams—high-frequency, low-information tokens such as{, }, [, ], ,, ;, =, \begin, 和, and\end——这会夸大分数，而不会反映出有意义的代码相似性。使用 Pygments 执行标记化—that would inflate scores without reflecting meaningful code similarity. Tokenization is performed using the Pygments文本分析器TexLexer，正确分割, which correctly segmentsLaTeX控制序列和类型标记control sequences, and tokens of type空白Whitespace和and评论Comment被丢弃。are discarded.

对于编辑任务，CrystalBLEU 也被分解为仅保留和仅编辑变体。仅限编辑的 CrystalBLEU 在计算 BLEU 之前对 GT 和生成的 n-gram 中的源 n-gram 执行多重集减法，从而隔离新引入的代码的贡献。仅保留变体仅保留与源相交的 n 元语法（计数器交集），衡量模型保留未更改代码部分的忠实程度。For the editing task, CrystalBLEU is also decomposed into preserve-only and edit-only variants. The edit-only CrystalBLEU performs multiset subtraction of source n-grams from both GT and generated n-grams before computing BLEU, isolating the contribution of newly introduced code. The preserve-only variant keeps only n-grams that intersect with the source (Counter intersection), measuring how faithfully the model retains unchanged code portions.

边缘情况。Edge cases.当给定维度的预测集和真实集都为空时（When both the predicted and ground-truth sets are empty for a given dimension (例如e.g.，两个代码都不包含任何文本元素），我们定义, neither code contains any text elements), we defineF1=1.0\mathrm{F1}=1.0（完美匹配），因为模型正确地没有生成该类型的元素。当颜色组包含(perfect match), since the model correctly produces no elements of that type. 在 D2C-E 中保留/编辑分割。Preserve/edit splits in D2C-E.对于图到代码的编辑任务，单个总体得分是不够的：编辑通常只更改图的一小部分，因此忽略编辑指令并简单地再现原始图的模型可能已经获得高分。因此，我们将评估分为两个互补的部分：For the diagram-to-code editing task, a single overall score is insufficient: an edit typically changes only a small portion of the diagram, so a model that ignores the editing instruction and simply reproduces the original diagram could already score high. We therefore split evaluation into two complementary parts:

(1) 仅保留评估衡量模型保留编辑后应保持不变的元素的程度。对于每个维度，我们仅保留生成代码和原始源代码（交集）中存在的元素，然后根据保留的真实元素计算 F1 分数。形式上，对于给定维度：(1) Preserve-only evaluation measures how well the model retains elements that should remain unchanged after editing. For each dimension, we keep only elements present in both the generated code and the original source code (intersection), then compute F1 score against the ground-truth preserved elements. Formally, for a given dimension:

  • •

    GT保留集GT preserve set：与源元素匹配的 GT 元素。: GT elements that match source elements.

  • •

    Gen 保留集Gen preserve set：生成的与源元素匹配的元素。: Generated elements that match source elements.

  • •

    F1 分数是在 GT 保留集和 Gen 保留集之间计算的。F1 score is computed between the GT preserve set and the Gen preserve set.

(2) 仅编辑评估隔离了实际编辑的质量。对于每个维度，在计算 F1 分数之前，从真实值和生成的代码中减去源和真实值之间共有的元素。这消除了未更改元素的贡献，并专门关注编辑指令要求更改的内容。正式：(2) Edit-only evaluation isolates the quality of the actual edits. For each dimension, elements common between the source and the ground-truth are subtracted from both the ground-truth and the generated code before computing F1 score. This eliminates the contribution of unchanged elements and focuses exclusively on what the editing instruction asks to change. Formally:

  • •

    普通套装Common set：源和 GT 中都存在的元素（通过贪婪匹配计算）。: Elements present in both source and GT (computed via greedy matching).

  • •

    GT编辑集GT edit set：去除公共集合后的 GT 元素。: GT elements after removing the common set.

  • •

    生成编辑集Gen edit set：去除公共集合后生成的元素。: Generated elements after removing the common set.

  • •

    F1 分数是在 GT 编辑集和 Gen 编辑集之间计算的。F1 score is computed between the GT edit set and the Gen edit set.

我们在保留和编辑分割上应用相同的过程进行基于对象和代码的度量计算。We apply the same procedure for object- and code-based metric computation on both preserve and edit splits.

C.3 DQA 法学硕士法官详细信息DQA LLM-as-a-Judge Details

我们通过两阶段管道评估 DQA 响应：基于规则的匹配，然后是针对不明确案例的法学硕士作为法官的后备。We evaluate DQA responses through a two-stage pipeline: rule-based matching followed by LLM-as-a-judge fallback for ambiguous cases.

第一阶段：答案提取。Stage 1: Answer extraction.模型的原始输出经过处理以提取最终答案。模型被指示返回 JSONThe model’s raw output is processed to extract the final answer. Models are instructed to return JSON{"answer": "...", "reasoning": "..."}，但实际输出可能包含 markdown 代码块、额外文本或格式错误的 JSON。提取器按顺序尝试四种策略：（1）直接JSON解析； (2) 从markdown中提取, but actual outputs may contain markdown code blocks, extra text, or malformed JSON. The extractor tries four strategies in order: (1) direct JSON parsing; (2) extraction from markdown'''json...'''‘‘‘json ... ‘‘‘代码块； (3)寻找最外层code blocks; (3) finding the outermost{...}大括号； (4) 正则表达式后备braces; (4) regex fallback for“回答”：“……”"answer": "..."模式。思维标签（patterns. Thinking tags (<思考>...<think>...</think>）在提取前被剥离。) are stripped before extraction.

第 2 阶段：基于规则的匹配。Stage 2: Rule-based matching.使用基于输出指令 (OI) 类型的特定于类型的规则，将提取的答案与基本事实进行比较：The extracted answer is compared against the ground truth using type-specific rules based on the output instruction (OI) type:

  • •

    OI-NUM（5,013 个问题，70.2%）：绝对公差的数值比较（(5,013 questions, 70.2%): Numeric comparison with absolute tolerance (≤10−6\leq 10^{-6}）或相对公差（) or relative tolerance (≤1%\leq 1\%），单位归一化（), with unit normalization (例如e.g.、“度”, “degrees”==“度”“deg”== “∘”; “安培””; “amps”==“A”）。“A”).

  • •

    OI-术语OI-TERM（1,779 个问题，24.9%）：标准化后不区分大小写的精确字符串匹配（删除引号、折叠空格、删除尾随标点符号）。(1,779 questions, 24.9%): Case-insensitive exact string match after normalization (removing quotes, collapsing whitespace, stripping trailing punctuation).

  • •

    石油清单OI-LIST（354 个问题，5.0%）：与顺序无关的集合比较。列表从 JSON 数组或 CSV 格式解析，并且在设置相等性检查之前对项目进行规范化。(354 questions, 5.0%): Order-independent set comparison. Lists are parsed from JSON arrays or CSV format, and items are normalized before set equality check.

每个规则都会产生一个置信度分数。当信心很高时（Each rule produces a confidence score. When confidence is high (≥0.85\geq 0.85），直接接受规则判决。当信心较低时（), the rule verdict is accepted directly. When confidence is low (例如e.g.、部分包含术语或不可解析的候选），该案例升级到第 3 阶段。, partial containment for terms, or unparseable candidate), the case is escalated to Stage 3.

第三阶段：法学硕士作为法官的后备。Stage 3: LLM-as-a-judge fallback.对于基于规则的匹配可信度较低的情况，我们使用法学硕士法官。给定一个问题、真实答案和模型的响应，我们提示法学硕士法官将响应分类为For cases where rule-based matching yields low confidence, we use an LLM judge. Given a question, the ground-truth answer, and the model’s response, we prompt the judge LLM to classify the response as正确Correct, 不正确Incorrect, 或, or未经尝试Unattempted。法官提示是类型感知的：它包括 OI 特定的指南（. The judge outputs a structured two-line response: (1) an evaluation explaining the reasoning, and (2) a label. The final binary score is 1 for正确Correct否则为 0。and 0 otherwise.

This deterministic treatment prevents missing data from inflating any model’s average performance.

E.1 基础评估提示Foundational Evaluation Prompts

这三个基本设置使用系统提示，指示模型直接执行任务，无需额外的上下文或工具。The three foundational settings use system prompts that instruct the model to perform the task directly without additional context or tools.

S1和S6共享相同的系统提示符；该任务通过用户消息来区分：S1仅发送图表图像，而S6还包括编辑文本指令。S1 and S6 share the same system prompt; the task is distinguished by the user message: S1 sends only the diagram image, while S6 additionally includes an editing textual instruction.

E.2 代理评估提示Agentic Evaluation Prompts

代理设置通过一种或多种功能增强了基础提示：上下文利用（提供结构化对象数据）、工具使用（通过 MCP 进行 TikZ 文档搜索）、状态管理（需要中间代码生成）和规划（协调多种功能）。下面，提示按任务组织。The agentic settings augment the foundational prompts with one or more capabilities: context utilization (providing structured object data), tool use (TikZ documentation search via MCP), state management (requiring intermediate code generation), and planning (coordinating multiple capabilities). Below, prompts are organized by task.

F.1 服务器架构与实现Server Architecture and Implementation

如§中所述As described in §3.5，我们将 TikZ 搜索工具构建为 MCP, we build the TikZ search tool as an MCP[27]服务器让模型按需访问精选的 TikZ 文档，避免网络搜索的噪音和加载完整手册的低效率。server to give models on demand access to curated TikZ documentation, avoiding the noise of web search and the inefficiency of loading full manuals.

管道概述。Pipeline overview.服务器搭建分三个阶段：从官方获取知识The server is built in three stages: knowledge extraction from officialLaTeX源文件、统一知识库构建、基于Mintlify的MCP部署，如图source files, unified knowledge base construction, and Mintlify based MCP deployment, as shown in FigureF.1.

第一阶段：知识提取。Stage 1: Knowledge extraction.我们从官方中提取结构化知识We extract structured knowledge from the officialLaTeX每个 TikZ 包手册的源文件。由于包使用不同的文档格式，我们实现了特定于包的提取器来解析示例、命令、选项和组件目录。该框架总共使用 7 个 Python 脚本处理来自 19 个包的约 270 个源文件。表source files of each TikZ package manual. Since packages use different documentation formats, we implement package specific extractors to parse examples, commands, options, and component catalogs. In total, the framework processes about 270 source files from 19 packages using seven Python scripts. TableF.1总结了六大核心包的提取策略。summarizes the extraction strategy for the six core packages.

第二阶段：知识库建设。Stage 2: Knowledge base construction.所有提取的项目都被标准化为统一的 JSON 模式。每个项目都存储其类型、包、名称、描述、相关代码或语法以及源文件。合并后的知识库共包含8809条，主要是可执行示例和命令规范。All extracted items are normalized into a unified JSON schema. Each item stores its type, package, name, description, relevant code or syntax, and source file. The merged knowledge base contains 8,809 items in total, mainly executable examples and command specifications.

第 3 阶段：MCP 服务器部署。Stage 3: MCP server deployment.结构化知识库被转换为 411 Mintlify 文档页面并通过 MCP 端点公开。服务器提供单一工具，The structured knowledge base is converted into 411 Mintlify documentation pages and exposed through an MCP endpoint. It supports keyword search, exact phrase search, command lookup, and Boolean operators. TableF.2显示跨基准域的代表性查询。shows representative queries across benchmark domains.

与 MLLM 集成。Integration with MLLMs.在代理评估期间，模型收到During agentic evaluation, models receive the搜索LaTeX知识库SearchLaTeXKnowledgeBase系统提示中的工具说明，可以根据需要调用。 MCP 设计与模型无关，因此任何 MCP 兼容客户端都可以连接到同一服务器，而无需实现特定于模型的工具。tool description in the system prompt and may invoke it as needed. 对于图表到代码的解析和编辑，所有模型都在 3D 形状上遇到困难：D2C-P 分数下降至 11.2% (TikZero+10B)，即使是最好的模型也保持在 40% 以下，这表明当前的 MLLM 无法感知三维空间关系并将其转换为 TikZ 代码。大多数模型在化学图上表现良好，因为 ChemFig 包通过键链语法显式地编码分子拓扑。图表是当前 MLLM 相对最简单的编辑域，可能是因为模型很容易将编辑指令融入节点边缘拓扑中。对 D2C-E 热图的仔细检查表明，仅保留分数高于仅编辑分数。例如，在图表中，仅编辑分数比仅保留分数低 10-20 分，这表明当前模型很好地保留了未触及的元素，但很难应用指示的修改。此外，开源模型和闭源模型在化学和电路图上的差距更大，特别是对于 D2C-P。For diagram-to-code parsing and editing, all models struggle on 3D Shapes: D2C-P scores drop as low as 11.2% (TikZero+10B), and even the best model stays below 40%, indicating that current MLLMs fail to perceive three-dimensional spatial relationships and translate them into TikZ code. Most models perform well on chemistry diagrams, as the ChemFig package encodes molecular topology explicitly through bond-chain syntax. Graph diagrams are the relatively easiest editing domain for current MLLMs, likely because models easily ground the editing instructions into node–edge topology. For example, in charts, edit-only scores fall 10–20 points below preserve-only, indicating that current models retain untouched elements well but struggle to apply the instructed modifications. Moreover, the gap between open-source and closed-source models is larger on chemistry and circuit diagrams, especially for D2C-P.

图结构是大多数模型最简单的领域，表现最好的模型的准确率超过 90% (Graph structures is the easiest domain for most models, with top-performing models exceeding 90% accuracy (例如e.g.，Gemini-3.1 Pro 为 91.34%）。这可能是因为与图相关的问题通常涉及计算节点或识别连接模式，这些是相对简单的视觉推理任务。, Gemini-3.1 Pro at 91.34%). 3D 形状始终是最难的 DQA 领域，即使是最好的模型得分也低于 69%。困难源于需要从渲染的图表中推理三维空间关系，例如视角和表面属性。3D Shapes is consistently the hardest DQA domain, with even the best models scoring below 69%. The difficulty stems from the need to reason about three-dimensional spatial relationships, such as viewing angles and surface properties, from rendered diagrams.

在开源模型中，Qwen3-VL-8B 显示出特别不均匀的领域性能：它在电路上达到 66.71%，但在化学上仅达到 27.05%，这表明较小的模型缺乏跨不同图表类型的泛化能力。相反，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 在所有领域保持相对平衡的准确度（66-88%），接近闭源性能。Among open-source models, Qwen3-VL-8B shows particularly uneven domain performance: it achieves 66.71% on Circuits but only 27.05% on chemistry, suggesting that smaller models lack generalization across diverse diagram types. Conversely, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B maintains relatively balanced accuracy (66–88%) across all domains, approaching closed-source performance.

代理评价。Agentic evaluation.正如所承认的（§As acknowledged (§3.5），我们并不声称Diagram-MMU评估了vibe写作框架中的全部代理能力。 Vibe 写作平台（), we do not claim Diagram-MMU evaluates the full spectrum of agentic ability in the vibe writing framework. Vibe writing platforms (例如e.g., 棱镜, Prism[12]）正变得越来越流行，因为任何研究人员都可以用自然语言提示模型直接生成学术论文) are becoming increasingly popular, as any researcher can prompt models in natural language to generate academic papers directly inLaTeX格式。常见需求包括在手稿中插入可编译的图表format. Common needs include inserting a diagram into the manuscript as compilableLaTeXTikZ 代码，根据论文内容进行特定编辑，或描述图表符号的特定领域含义。我们的评估设置通过图表到代码和图表理解任务来针对氛围写作的多模式方面。TikZ code, applying specific edits based on the paper content, or describing the domain-specific meaning of diagram symbols. Our evaluation settings target such multimodal aspects of vibe writing through diagram-to-code and diagram understanding tasks.

然而，氛围写作工作区涉及更广泛的功能，例如文本起草、引文管理和布局格式化，这些功能超出了我们的范围，并且需要为纯文本功能设计代理评估设置。此外，当前基准测试也未涵盖更广泛的代理功能，例如长期任务分解、跨异构环境的多工具编排、通过执行反馈进行自我纠正以及与人类用户的交互式协作。However, the vibe writing workspace involves broader capabilities such as text drafting, citation management, and layout formatting, which remain outside our scope and would require designing agentic evaluation settings for purely textual abilities. Moreover, broader agentic capabilities such as long-horizon task decomposition, multi-tool orchestration across heterogeneous environments, self-correction via execution feedback, and interactive collaboration with human users are also not covered by the current benchmark.

代码表示。Code representation.示意图-MMU采用Diagram-MMU adoptsLaTeXTikZ 作为代码表示，其输出在其中内联编译TikZ as the code representation, whose output compiles inline withinLaTeX创作环境。但在实践中，研究人员也创造了科学 带有 Python 库的图表 (authoring environments. But, in practice, researchers also create scientific diagrams with Python libraries (例如e.g.、Matplotlib、Seaborn）、SVG/HTML 工具或其他, Matplotlib, Seaborn), SVG/HTML tools, or otherLaTeX绘图包（drawing packages (例如e.g., 普斯特里克斯pstricks, xy-图片xy-pic），目前Diagram-MMU的评估设置不包括这些。), which are currently not covered by the evaluation settings of Diagram-MMU.

未来的方向。Future directions.在未来的工作中，我们计划扩展代理设置来评估：（1）科学写作中更广泛的文本和布局功能，例如文本到 TikZ 的生成、数据的表格构建以及数学推导格式化； (2)更丰富的代理工作流程，包括执行反馈循环、迭代人机循环细化和多工具编排，反映了氛围写作的现实需求。对于代码表示，将 Python 或 SVG 图表转换为 TikZ 的跨语言转换管道将扩大覆盖范围，同时保留内联In future work, we plan to extend agentic settings to evaluate: (1) broader textual and layout capabilities in scientific writing, such as text-to-TikZ generation, table construction from data, and mathematical derivation formatting; and (2) richer agentic workflows, including execution feedback loops, iterative human-in-the-loop refinement, and multi-tool orchestration, that reflect the real-world demands of vibe writing. For code representation, cross-language conversion pipelines that translate Python or SVG diagrams into TikZ would expand coverage while preserving inlineLaTeX编译并支持通过图像上传导入图表将允许 vibe 写作工作区摄取图表。或者，将评估扩展到其他compilation, and supporting diagram import via image upload would allow vibe writing workspaces to ingest figures. Alternatively, extending evaluation to additionalLaTeXTikZ 之外的绘图包（drawing packages beyond TikZ (例如e.g., 普斯特里克斯pstricks, xy-图片xy-pic）将扩大覆盖范围) would broaden coverage within theLaTeX直接生态系统。对于图表理解和推理，我们计划转向专家级问题，并纳入更丰富的上下文，例如周围论文中的图形标题，从而能够评估基于完整手稿的图表理解。ecosystem directly. For diagram understanding and reasoning, we plan to move toward expert-level questions, and to incorporate richer context such as figure captions from the surrounding paper, enabling evaluation of diagram comprehension grounded in the full manuscript.

我们希望未来版本的Diagram-MMU能够提供更全面的见解，并通过查明模型失败的地方来指导有针对性的改进：无论是基础能力（感知、编码、知识、推理）还是代理能力（上下文利用、工具使用、状态管理、规划）。我们做 无法预见负面的社会后果；该基准测试是根据公开的 TikZ 文档构建的，不包含私人或敏感数据。We hope future versions of Diagram-MMU can provide more comprehensive insights and guide targeted improvements by pinpointing where models fail: whether in foundational abilities (perception, coding, knowledge, reasoning) or agentic abilities (context utilization, tool use, state management, planning). We do not foresee negative societal consequences; the benchmark is constructed from publicly available TikZ documentation and contains no private or sensitive data.
